notes.title: Update patch:1.9.0
notes.content:
(Added): New Building - Dye Workshop: allows changing Dino colors.
(Added): New Building - Altar: allows extracting/installing Dino Talents and enhancing basic stats.
(Added): New Training Ground: freely test Totems and Pet combinations.
(Added): New Time Rift gameplay mode: includes Casual Mode and Challenge Mode.
(Added): New Time Rift gameplay mode: 2-Player Mode.
(Added): New Time Rift gameplay mode: Single/2-Player Ranking System.
(Added): New Pet Kapi Bee: available randomly in the Capybara Store.
(Added): New Carrier Pigeon system: grants time-limited Equipment Exchange Vouchers. 
(Added): New female outfit available when creating a character.
(Added): New outfits at the Equipment Rack: Aerowing (Female) and Stormwing (Male) outfits, redeemable with vouchers.
(Added): New items: Dyes, Attribute Fruits, Talent Clear Fruits, Talent Extract Fruits, and specific Talent Fruits, all obtainable in Time Rift. 
(Adjusted): Summoned creatures now inherit Dino's attributes, including Damage Bonus, Physical Damage Bonus, Elemental Damage Bonus, Crit Rate, and Crit Damage.
(Adjusted): All summoned creatures’ HP doubled.
(Fixed): Fixed image stretching issue under 21:9 resolution.

(Adjusted) Dinos Skill Adjustments - 
Stormwing:
Lightning Chain: Changed from 40 Elemental Damage → 0.58 × Attack Power Elemental Damage.
Sylvanantler:
Plant Guardian: Summon duration changed from 30s → Infinite, and can now carry over to the next stage.
Buddybeak:
Chain Shot Dance: Crit Rate bonus changed from 100% → 50%.
Cindarok:
Flame Whirl: No longer absorbs projectiles.
Speedy:
Shield Chance: Shield gain chance reduced from 25% → 10%.
Mr. Mochu:
Life-Guard Cycle: When HP is at 1, skill no longer consumes HP but still restores shield.
Vexora:
Vex Cleave: Internal cooldown for restoring Action Power reduced from 0.25s → 0.1s.
Vex Fury: Damage changed from 100%/150%/200%/250%/300% Action Power →
(50%/75%/100%/125%/150% × Action Power) + (1/1.5/2/2.5/3 × Attack Power).
Qynaxx:

(Adjusted) Totem Adjustments:
Spiritual Rebirth: Healing changed from 2/3/4/5/6 → 4/6/8/10/12.
(Adjusted) Totem Adjustments:
Summoner’s Pact: HP regen changed from 2/4/8 per second → 4/8/16 per second.
Destructive Burst: Self-destruction damage changed from 500%/1000%/2000% → 250%/500%/1000%.

notes.title: Dinotica – Major Update Announcement of this Week
notes.content:
[b]Dear Dino Tamers,[/b]

First and foremost, the Dinotica development team wants to thank all of you for your incredible support! 

Since launch, we have been pushing frequent updates while carefully listening to your feedback to refine and improve the game. Our dedication comes not just from our love for Dinotica, but also from the passion you have shown us.

Based on player feedback, the key concerns we have addressed are:
BOSS Eggs are too rare
It takes too much time to hatch & breed Dino
high battle difficulty
Quality of the game connection & multiplayer

✦ This Week Update forecast ✦
✅ BOSS Egg appearance & drop rates increased
Hard Mode: 33% → Over 50%
✅ New "Multi-Gate Challenge" system – Allowing you to choose the Boos you want to challenge 
Easy: 2 Gates
Hard: 3 Gates
Nightmare: 3 Gates
✅ Blessings now greatly speed up breeding & hatching!
✅ Underused Blessings removed & replaced with new buffs and passive.
We may be a small team of nine, but we take every suggestion to heart and keep polishing Dinotica with each update. Thank you for being part of this adventure—it would not be the same without you!

[b]— The Dinotica Dev Team[/b]
(Still busting the hump… 💪)

notes.title: Apology and Game Name Change Announcement
notes.content: [p]We recently learned that the game name DinoTopia is the same as the well-known work Dinotopia by author and illustrator James Gurney, which may have caused confusion or inconvenience. This was never our intention, and we sincerely apologize.[/p][p]To prevent further misunderstanding, we are changing the game’s name to Dinotica, which better reflects our original vision and game world. All related names and materials will be updated shortly, with progress communicated to our community.[/p][p]Due to the name change, the update will be applied at 7:15 PM (UTC+8). If players encounter errors when entering the game during this period, please restart the game and try again. Rest assured, this update will not affect any player’s game data or progress.[/p][p]We sincerely thank our players for their support and understanding during this period, and again apologize to Mr. Gurney and the community that treasures his work. We will continue striving to provide better content and experiences.[/p][p][/p][p]- Dinotica Team[/p]

notes.title: 08/14 Update patch 1.0.1
notes.content: [p]Dear Dino Tamers,[/p][p]  "Dinotica" released a minor update on August 14, addressing the following fixes and adjustments.  【Bug Fixes, Improvements & Adjustments】  - Fixed: Issue with missing translation for Training Ground combat power. - Fixed: In battle, clicking the skill icon in the upper left corner of the screen with the mouse to release skills could not choose the direction of the skill release; it would default to releasing from the center of the map to the left. - Adjusted: The Mimic will not disappear after killing other mobs, and the Mimic also counts as an objective monster in the stage, meaning it must be defeated to clear the level. - Fixed: When selling wood in bulk, it displayed selling for 10 stone coins, but actually only sold for 7. - Fixed: Issue with home gate being able to pass through. - Fixed: Modified the slowing smoke effect for the level 3 Lava Fire Fish boss. - Fixed: Issue where effects did not disappear after being frozen during a charge. - Fixed: Now compatible with PS and Xbox controllers, displaying corresponding button prompts. - Adjusted: Poison explosion totem, quality color corrected to purple. - Adjusted: Issue where the edges of the home construction grid could not be dragged. - New: Host players can generate an invitation code, and secondary players can enter directly using the invitation code. notes.title: “Dinotica” Official Launch!
notes.content:
[p][b]Dear Dino Tamers,[/b][/p][p]Big news!! After months of DEMO playtesting, [b]Dinotica[/b] has officially launched tonight at [b]9:00 PM (Aug 12)[/b] on Steam as an [b]Early Access[/b]! 🎉[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502436/70d92bb5165f0abe3f432fc9fab2f17392548809.jpg"][/img]

This version will [b][i][u]not[/u][/i][/b] wipe progress - all your gameplay records will be permanently saved, so you can officially begin your adventure in the prehistoric world![/p][p]In addition, the development team has prepared an [b]exclusive limited-time outfit[/b] as a free gift for all players who participated in the DEMO! Now, let’s take a look at the exciting content in the EA version~[/p][p][b]Dinotica[/b] Official Price: [b]USD $17.99 Early Access Launch Discount:[/b] Enjoy [b]10% off[/b] during the first 14 days (Aug 12 – Aug 26, 9:00 PM UTC+8)

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3336520/Dino_Topia/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]6 Brand-New Outfits Arrive[/b][/h3][p]The EA version will feature [b]6 uniquely styled outfits[/b], which Dino Tamers can unlock one by one as they progress through the game, becoming the most stylish caveman around

[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502436/002f8fcc74d3e7500f97083b6f22957fce825982.jpg"][/img][/carousel][h3][b]Explore the Main Story Chapters - Bosses Await Your Challenge![/b][/h3][p]As the core gameplay of [i]Dinotica[/i], the main story mode in the EA version will let you experience:[/p][list][*][p][b]4 main story chapters[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Three selectable difficulty levels[/b] for each chapter[/p][/*][*][p]Travel through [b]4 distinct terrains[/b] - Emerald Forest, Lost Sands, Eternal Ice field, and Flame Rift. Face off against [b]a total of 60 bosses[/b], each with unique appearances, animations, and skills[/p][/*][/list][p]Completing the main story will also unlock various [b]base buildings[/b] and your loyal companion - the [b]Dino Beast[/b]!

[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502436/b3a77bc2739b5c2ab47ed8a0c06417501b5fc711.jpg"][/img][/carousel][h3]Raise Your Dinos– Recruit Allies in the Primitive World[/h3][p]To survive in the primitive world, raising Dinos will be one of your most important missions.[/p][p]In the EA version, you can collect and train 40 different Dinos, each with unique appearances, talents, and abilities.[/p][p]They are divided into three main types:[/p][list][*][p]Ferocious Combat Type – excels in direct battles[/p][/*][*][p]Support Type – provides buffs to allies[/p][/*][*][p]Gathering Type – specializes in collecting resources [/p][/*][/list][p]Combat-type dinos come with a variety of skills and attack patterns, helping you adapt to different stages. During training, you can also enhance attributes and rank up stars to further improve their attack, defense, and other stats![/p][p]
[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502436/4fe823dd7f95ccd8c29ef3d455219011a99ee7a3.jpg"][/img][/carousel][h3]Find Lost Totems and Relics – Unlock the Potential of Your Dino Beasts[/h3][p]If you want to challenge various ancient beasts, you’ll need the power of the 39 hidden totems and 70 unique relics scattered across the world.[/p][p]These lost treasures can greatly enhance your Dino's - for example, increasing their attack speed, enabling multi-hit combos, or even altering their attack attributes.[/p][p]You can imbue their strikes with the forces of nature - such as flames or whirlwinds-boosting damage and triggering powerful additional effects.[/p][p]
[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502436/065d419fed8c4095d55c78f678429bd907560694.jpg"][/img][/carousel][h3]Build Your Base – Create a Cozy Haven in the Primitive World[/h3][p]After thrilling adventures in the wild, every Dino Tamer and their Dino Beasts deserve a beautiful home.[/p][p]In this version, over 40 types of base buildings will be available to meet all your survival needs, including:[/p][list][*][p]Basic Facilities: Houses, Warehouses[/p][/*][*][p]Production Facilities: Various Workshops, Farmland[/p][/*][*][p]Functional Buildings: Incubators, Technology Stations[/p][/*][/list][p]With decorative structures for beautification, you can freely design and build a home that’s uniquely yours.[/p][p]Your home is also where support-type Dinos truly shine - hauling building materials, speeding up construction, boosting workshop production, helping with farming, They’ll be your most reliable partners in creating a warm and cozy haven.[/p][p]
[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502436/1e56452c3f9163874cad2f52efc8df312aa19ae5.jpg"][/img][/carousel][h3]Two-Player Adventure – Explore the Primitive World Together[/h3][p]Even with Dinos by your side, the journey can feel a little lonely. No worries - the EA version fully supports both local connection and online co-op. All battle stages, base management, and other activities can be completed in two-player co-op. Two players can field up to 4 Dinos at the same time, doubling your power and doubling the fun![/p][p]Beyond combat advantages, the EA version also introduces Co-op Egg Incubation, giving you higher efficiency and a greater chance to hatch rare, high-tier Dinos.[/p][p]Even more two-player features await - grab a friend and start discovering them together!   

[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502436/99240c2f94b9f8964057c22fc66e6407b7dfb494.jpg"][/img][/carousel][h3]Exclusive Rewards - Stylish Outfit & Physical Merchandise Await![/h3][p]To celebrate the EA launch, the development team of Dino Ranchers has prepared an all-new exclusive “Cunningar” limited-time outfit as a special gift for players who took part in the DEMO-our heartfelt thanks for being with us on this journey.[/p][p] [/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502436/f26a1cb055f6f610c1d7526eddd7a09b5af1c1fb.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p]Purchase the game before 9:00 PM (UTC+8) on August 26 to enjoy an exclusive 10% OFF![/p][p]During the discount period, accumulate [b]2+ hours of playtime[/b] and join our massive [b]Pioneer Challenge[/b] event![/p][p]📸 [b]How to join:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Play the game for [b]2+ hours[/b] during the discount period.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Leave a review[/b] for the game on Steam.[/p][/*][*][p]Take a screenshot showing your [b]playtime[/b] and your [b]review[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Submit the screenshot to [b]either[/b] our official QQ Group ([b]907096102[/b]) [b]or[/b] [url="https://discord.com/invite/SSat32wC9" style="button"][b]Discord channel[/b][/url][/p][/*][*][p][i](Each player can only join via one channel, so pick whichever is easier for you!)[/i][/p][/*][/olist][p]🏆 [b]Prizes:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]1st Prize (1,000 winners)[/b] – Exclusive Gift Box [i](Themed Card + badges + Keychain Set)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]2nd Prize (1,000 winners)[/b] – Themed Badges[/p][/*][*][p][b]3rd Prize (2,000 winners)[/b] – Themed Keychain[/p][/*][/list][p]🎁 Winners will receive a [b]redemption code[/b] after verification.[/p][p]There’s even more exciting content and surprises waiting for you in the prehistoric world.

notes.title: 🦖 Dinotica – Second Closed Beta Test Begins!
notes.content:
[p][b]Dear Dino Tamers,[/b][/p][p]The [b]Second Closed Beta Test (CBT)[/b] for [i]Dinotica[/i] kicks off [b]today[/b]![/p][p]This test includes [b]all newly added features[/b], and for the first time ever, you'll gain access to full content , including the [b]four mystical dungeons[/b], each filled with epic battles, hidden treasures, and powerful Dino companions.[/p][p]🦖 [b]CBT access is limited[/b] to a selected group of players. Follow our Discord for more information. [/p][p]🕹️ Not selected? No worries — you can still try the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3488860/Dino_Topia_Demo/https://"]demo[/url] version to get a taste of the world and     gameplay while the CBT is running.[/p][p]📅 [b]CBT Duration:[/b] [b]One week
[/b][/p][h3][b]

notes.title: Dinotica Closed Beta Has Ended – Thank You for Taming With Us!
notes.content: [h2]🦕 Dinotica Closed Beta Has Ended – Thank You, Tamers![/h2][p]Dear Dino Tamers,[/p][p]The [b]closed beta test for [i]Dinotica[/i] has officially ended[/b], and we want to extend a huge thank you to every single one of you who joined the adventure![/p][p]Your feedback, bug reports, and enthusiasm have been incredibly valuable to our team. From taming dino companions to building your prehistoric homes and braving the dungeons, your participation has helped us shape a better, more polished game.[/p][p]This is just the beginning — we’ll be reviewing all your input and making improvements as we prepare for the next phase of development. 🛠️[/p][p]🛒 If you haven’t already, please [b]add [i]Dinotica[/i] to your Steam wishlist[/b] to stay updated on future updates, events, and the full release![/p][p]Once again, thank you for being part of this early journey. We can’t wait to show you what’s next![/p][p]🦖 — The [i]Dinotica[/i] Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: 🦕 Dinotica Beta Extended – Thank You for the Amazing Support!
notes.content: [p]Hey Dino Tamers![/p][p]We launched the [b]Dinotica Beta Test[/b] on [b]May 30[/b], originally planning to wrap things up on [b]June 17[/b]. But… wow! 💥 The response has been far better than we expected — and we’ve heard from so many of you who still want to join the adventure![/p][p]To give more players a chance to explore, build, and battle with their dino companions, we’ve decided to [b]extend the beta test until June 29[/b]! 🎉[/p][p]Whether you're just getting started or have been playing since day one, there's still time to jump into the world of Dinotica, try out the dungeons, and share your feedback with us.[/p][p]🛒 Don’t forget to [b]wishlist Dinotica on Steam[/b] to stay updated on future updates and the full launch![/p][p]Thanks again to everyone who has supported us so far. You’re helping us shape a better game, and we can’t wait to show you what’s next.[/p][p]🦕 — The Dinotica Dev Team[/p]
